newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bank Negara Indonesia offer already oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara Indonesia offer already oversubscribed.

text.p: Preliminary applications for shares in PT Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI), the country's largest state-owned bank which is to list next month, already total seven times the number of shares on offer, the lead underwriter said on Tuesday.
An official from PT Danareksa Sekuritas said the oversubscription was expected to increase sharply during the November 4-7 offer period.
"It is expected to be heavily oversubscribed as more individual investors are likely to apply during the offer period," he said.
The bank will float around 1.1 billion shares on the Jakarta and Surabaya stock exchanges on November 25. The offer price is 850 rupiah per share.
A BNI official said the bank will allocate 10 percent of the total number of shares to its employees, who will be disallowed from selling them for at least one year.
